union(tables: [u, k]) |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testRunID == "${baselineRun}" and r.transaction =~ /^${transaction:regex}$/) |> group() |> quantile(q: ${latencyStat}, method: "estimate_tdigest") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Baseline" }))

k = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration" and r._field == "value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))

k = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_failed" and r._field == "value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
union(tables: [u, k]) |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testRunID == "${baselineRun}" and r.transaction =~ /^${transaction:regex}$/) |> group() |> mean() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Baseline", _value: r._value * 100.0 }))

u = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "performance_http_request" and r._field == "failed") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value then 1.0 else 0.0 }))
k = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_failed" and r._field == "value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
union(tables: [u, k]) |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testRunID == "${targetRun}" and r.transaction =~ /^${transaction:regex}$/) |> group() |> mean() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Target", _value: r._value * 100.0 }))

latencyU = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "performance_http_request" and r._field == "response_time_ms") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
latencyK = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration" and r._field == "value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
latency = union(tables: [latencyU, latencyK]) |> filter(fn: (r) => r.transaction =~ /^${transaction:regex}$/)
errorsU = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "performance_http_request" and r._field == "failed") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value then 1.0 else 0.0 }))
errorsK = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_failed" and r._field == "value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
errors = union(tables: [errorsU, errorsK]) |> filter(fn: (r) => r.transaction =~ /^${transaction:regex}$/)
bLatency = latency |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testRunID == "${baselineRun}")
tLatency = latency |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testRunID == "${targetRun}")
bErrors = errors |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testRunID == "${baselineRun}")
tErrors = errors |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testRunID == "${targetRun}")
bCount = bLatency |> group(columns: ["transaction"]) |> count() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Baseline count", _value: float(v: r._value) }))
tCount = tLatency |> group(columns: ["transaction"]) |> count() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Target count", _value: float(v: r._value) }))
bAvg = bLatency |> group(columns: ["transaction"]) |> mean() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Baseline Avg" }))
tAvg = tLatency |> group(columns: ["transaction"]) |> mean() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Target Avg" }))
bSelected = bLatency |> group(columns: ["transaction"]) |> quantile(q: ${latencyStat}, method: "estimate_tdigest") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Baseline latency" }))
tSelected = tLatency |> group(columns: ["transaction"]) |> quantile(q: ${latencyStat}, method: "estimate_tdigest") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Target latency" }))
bErrorRate = bErrors |> group(columns: ["transaction"]) |> mean() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Baseline Error %", _value: r._value * 100.0 }))
tErrorRate = tErrors |> group(columns: ["transaction"]) |> mean() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Target Error %", _value: r._value * 100.0 }))
union(tables: [bCount, tCount, bErrorRate, tErrorRate, bAvg, tAvg, bSelected, tSelected])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["transaction"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with latency_delta_pct: if r["Baseline latency"] == 0.0 then 0.0 else (r["Target latency"] - r["Baseline latency"]) / r["Baseline latency"] * 100.0 }))
  |> rename(columns: {transaction: "Request", latency_delta_pct: "Latency delta %"})
  |> keep(columns: ["Request", "Baseline count", "Target count", "Baseline Error %", "Target Error %", "Baseline Avg", "Target Avg", "Baseline latency", "Target latency", "Latency delta %"])
  |> sort(columns: ["Latency delta %"], desc: true)
